summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 4 new features: Transfer-aware attendance, Transfer-aware payroll, International PDF export, and Refactored HR Letters/Centers/Managers endpoints. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working.

transfer_aware_attendance.details: attendance_month returns transfer_tag (HOME, TRANSFERRED_IN, TRANSFERRED_OUT) and transfer_info for each employee. attendance_by_date returns transferred_in_names and transferred_out_names arrays. bulk_attendance returns skipped_transferred_out count.

transfer_aware_employees.details: /api/employees returns transfer_tag, transfer_from, transfer_to for transferred employees

transfer_aware_payroll.details: /api/salary_preview returns transferTag and workingCenter fields for each employee. Attendance is fetched from actual working center for transferred employees.

international_pdf_export.details: /api/international-attendance/export/monthly-pdf returns valid PDF with correct content-type and PDF magic bytes. UI shows Monthly Payroll PDF card with red Export PDF button.

refactored_centers_managers.details: /api/mgt/centers and /api/mgt/managers endpoints working correctly (refactored from server.py to routes/centers_managers.py)

refactored_hr_letters.details: /api/hr_letter/employees endpoint working correctly (refactored from server.py to routes/hr_letters.py). HR Letters Generator page loads with signatory selection and letter type tabs.

attendance_page_ui.details: Attendance Dashboard loads correctly with Daily/Monthly/Advances tabs. Load Employees button works. Transfer badges present in DOM (ArrowRightLeft icon imported).

salary_page_ui.details: Salary Generation page loads correctly. Preview Salary shows employee table with columns: Employee, Designation, Center, Monthly, Days, Gross, Advance, Net Salary.

managers_page_ui.details: Managers Management page shows 13 managers across 9 centers with contact info and status.

seed_data_creation: None - used existing data including ASHA transfer from PB-PERTH to PB-HSR
context_for_next_testing_agent: Transfer-aware features fully working: 1) Attendance endpoints return transfer_tag (HOME/TRANSFERRED_IN/TRANSFERRED_OUT) and transfer_info, 2) bulk_attendance skips transferred-out employees, 3) salary_preview includes transferTag and workingCenter, 4) International PDF export at /api/international-attendance/export/monthly-pdf returns valid PDF, 5) HR Letters refactored to routes/hr_letters.py with /api/hr_letter prefix, 6) Centers/Managers refactored to routes/centers_managers.py with /api/mgt prefix. ASHA is an existing transferred employee from PB-PERTH to PB-HSR.
